Naman Tiwari is an Indian cricketer who has played for the India Under-19 cricket team. During the 2026 IPL auction, he was bought by Lucknow Super Giants for ₹1 crore. Prior to that, he was selected in India's squad for the 2024 Under-19 Cricket World Cup. In that tournament, he took 12 wickets at an economy of 5.17 in the six matches he played.
Early life
Naman Tiwari was born on November 8, 2005.
IPL career
Prior to Lucknow Super Giants buying him, he had been a net bowler for the Rajasthan Royals in 2022 and also a net bowler for Lucknow Super Giants in 2024. Eventually, Lucknow Super Giants bought him for INR 1 crore in the IPL 2026 auction.
